The '''YZ 3000 tanker''' was a model of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] vessel. The YZ 3000 was colloquially known as a '''"Whale"''' due to its massive size and shape.

==History==
These transports were used to haul [[Water/Legends|water]] from [[Da Soocha]] to its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Napdu]] in [[137 ABY]] for use in the [[Maya Armus]] spa. The [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] used several of these to evacuate [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Genocide on Dac|refugees]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Gar Stazi]] soon after called them back into service during the [[Evacuation of Dac]], where they were used to save [[Whaladon/Legends|Whaladons]] and [[Moappa]].
